description: Final per-candidate BUY/PASS decisions produced by the LLM council chair. Consumed by pipeline --execute.

date.description: Session date (YYYY-MM-DD), matches the dossiers file date.

independent_lineages_considered.description: Distinct model/vendor lineages weighed by the chair, not analyst seats.

position_size_pct.description: Percent of equity. 0 on PASS; 0.5/1.0/1.5 tiers on BUY.

take_profit_r.description: Take-profit expressed as R multiple. Null on PASS.

trailing_atr_mult.description: ATR multiple for the trailing stop. Null on PASS.

title: CouncilDecisions
